verify:round-ui.recommendation_critique:
The overall direction is sound and backed by the sources. Reuse xiaozhi's MIT ST77916 bring-up and audio pins, render in PARTIAL mode with internal DMA double buffers, avoid transforms, Lottie and large shadows, and design the UI in a simulator. Several specific prescriptions are wrong or risky:

1. Root screen clip_corner is a performance anti-pattern. In LVGL 9.5 lv_refr.c, clip_corner with radius 180 on a 360px screen renders every child into ARGB8888 layers for the top and bottom rounded bands, which together cover the whole screen, and then applies a mask on every redraw. Those layers are allocated from the LVGL heap, which the plan puts in PSRAM. The bezel already hides the corners physically, so keep content inside the circle through layout and drop clip_corner at the root. The scroll_6 curved-list pattern also uses clip_corner, so use it only on small containers or replace it with a plain fade.

2. The keyboard geometry does not fit as written. With the plan's own 12px rim padding (r = 168), usable widths are:
- y = 330 (d = 150): about 151px, so about 3 keys of 46px
- row 3 (lower edge d ≈ 98): about 273px, so about 5 keys
- rows 1-2: about 6 keys each
That is about 20 keys per page, not 4 rows of 6-7. The 46-52px keys are also below the plan's own touch minimum (40dp ≈ 49px, 48dp ≈ 58px). LVGL docs warn that popovers extend past the widget, so they will be clipped near the rim. A 3x4/T9 layout (Samsung precedent) or a two-step group-then-letter picker fits 33 Russian letters better. The 'rotary rim picker inspired by COMPASS' rests on a study of non-touch, physical-bezel watches.

3. The TE fallback ('TE on GPIO18 with FULL mode') is not a drop-in:
- Neither init table sends TEON.
- Espressif's TE example is i80.
- esp_lvgl_adapter documents QSPI as tearing mode NONE only.
- FULL mode needs 259KB PSRAM buffers, PSRAM DMA bandwidth is 'very limited', and PSRAM is inaccessible whenever flash cache is disabled (NVS or OTA writes).
Treat it as a research spike.

4. FADE is not cheaper than MOVE. A screen fade invalidates the whole 360x360 every frame and adds opacity blending. Tileview swipes are also full-screen scrolls, and they conflict with the scrolling chat, curved lists and hold-to-talk gestures. Prefer short or instant page switches and animate small in-screen elements. Also consider the physical BOOT (GPIO0) and PWR (GPIO6) buttons for push-to-talk and mode changes.

5. LVGL version. Pinning 9.5 is fine: 9.6 only cut render time about 4% on an ESP32-S3 board. But 9.6 deprecates lv_menu and lv_list and replaces the lv_subject_init_* API, so avoid those widgets and wrap subject creation so an upgrade is cheap.

6. Thread safety is missing. Every LVGL call or subject change from the audio, Wi-Fi or HTTP tasks must hold lvgl_port_lock. Feed the 20-30Hz mic-RMS ring through an atomic value read by an LVGL timer.

7. Captive portal. esp-wifi-connect cannot take an API key or model id without modifying its embedded page.

8. Roller INFINITE mode duplicates the option text across pages, and OpenRouter lists hundreds of models. Use a curated short list, with custom model ids entered through the portal.

9. Font range. LLM replies routinely contain em dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis, № and markdown or emoji. Add U+2010-2027 and U+2116, sanitise the markdown, and chain a fallback font (lv_font_conv --lv-fallback) so missing glyphs don't render as boxes.

10. Rollback. OTA rollback only protects images installed through esp_ota with CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE and an esp_ota_mark_app_valid_cancel_rollback call. During USB development the real rollback is git tags plus an archived .bin per tag (the BOOT button always gives download mode), plus versioned NVS settings so older firmware can still read them.
missing: clip_corner cost: lv_refr.c (v9.5) renders children into ARGB8888 layers plus lv_draw_mask_rect for the rounded bands on every redraw; with a 360px circle that covers the whole screen. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvgl/lvgl/release/v9.5/src/core/lv_refr.c

Neither esp_lcd_st77916's default init nor xiaozhi's alternate init sends TEON (0x35), and the component's QSPI IO macro defaults to 40MHz (xiaozhi overrides it to 80MHz). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/espressif/esp-iot-solution/master/components/display/lcd/esp_lcd_st77916/esp_lcd_st77916_spi.c

esp_lvgl_adapter (Espressif's alternative to esp_lvgl_port) documents SPI/QSPI as tearing mode NONE only. https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-iot-solution/en/latest/display/tools/esp_lvgl_adapter.html

Every LVGL call from other tasks must be wrapped in lvgl_port_lock()/lvgl_port_unlock(). esp_lvgl_port 2.7.1+ also offers rounder_cb if the ST77916 shows odd-alignment artefacts; xiaozhi runs this panel without a rounder. https://github.com/espressif/esp-bsp/blob/master/components/esp_lvgl_port/README.md

LVGL 9.6 (released 2026-09-16, the last v9 release): the ESP32-S3-Korvo-1 shows only -4% render time; lv_list, lv_win and lv_menu are deprecated; public headers move to include/lvgl; LV_COLOR_DEPTH becomes LV_COLOR_FORMAT_DEFAULT; subject init becomes lv_subject_create/delete. https://lvgl.io/blog/release-v9-6

ESP32-S3 PSRAM is inaccessible while the flash cache is disabled (NVS or OTA writes), DMA bandwidth to PSRAM is very limited, and task stacks are internal by default. All of this affects putting the LVGL heap, layers and full-frame buffers in PSRAM. https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/stable/esp32s3/api-guides/external-ram.html

OTA rollback needs two OTA slots, otadata, CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE and an explicit esp_ota_mark_app_valid_cancel_rollback(); it does not protect USB-flashed builds. https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/stable/esp32s3/api-reference/system/ota.html

The board has two I2C buses: the main one on GPIO10/11 (TCA9554 at address 000, PCF85063 RTC, QMI8658 IMU) and the touch bus on GPIO1/3 as I2C_NUM_1. It has physical BOOT (GPIO0) and PWR (GPIO6) buttons, and a PWR_Control latch on GPIO7 that firmware drives high at boot. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/78/xiaozhi-esp32/main/main/boards/waveshare/esp32-s3-touch-lcd-1.85/config.h

The ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.85C is a different board, with ES8311/ES7210 codecs and its own xiaozhi folder, so the user's exact model should be confirmed before copying pins. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/78/xiaozhi-esp32/main/main/boards/waveshare/esp32-s3-touch-lcd-1.85c/config.h
LVGL docs say keyboard popovers extend past the widget bounds, so on a round panel the top-row and edge popovers will be clipped. https://lvgl.io/docs/open/widgets/keyboard

lv_roller INFINITE mode multiplies the option list across inf_page_cnt pages, which does not suit long OpenRouter model lists. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lvgl/lvgl/release/v9.5/src/widgets/roller/lv_roller.c

Montserrat, Inter and Noto Sans all ship Cyrillic and Cyrillic-ext subsets on Google Fonts, and Montserrat is SIL OFL 1.1. LLM output also needs General Punctuation (U+2010-2027) and № (U+2116), or a fallback font. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JulietaUla/Montserrat/master/OFL.txt
esp-wifi-connect also supports SmartConfig (ESPTouch v2) as a no-typing alternative for Wi-Fi provisioning. https://github.com/78/esp-wifi-connect
Unverified: C-QWERTY and WrisText details, the CST816 variant and gesture support on rev 2.1, real FPS on this board, and whether the ST77916 panel's TE line is actually driven once TEON is sent.
